catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled · independent review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Current NCCP00319 v5 including oral schedule, count-table underline symbols, organ dosing and unresolved platelet/CrCl bands reconciled. Independent approval pending.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
metadata.source_retrieval_method: Current official PDF downloaded; complete text reviewed and pages 1–4 treatment, Calvert and dose tables visually inspected

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist. All dose modifications require consultant discussion.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Respect oral route and consultant-dependent decisions. Do not convert IV etoposide doses, calculate unresolved table boundaries, or multiply overlapping renal/hepatic/toxicity percentages.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00319 Version 5. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

treatment.schedule_summary: Carboplatin AUC5 IV Day1 before oral etoposide100 mg/m² twice daily Days1–3; repeat every21days until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
treatment.duration: Until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity; no fixed cycle count in this source.

hypersensitivity.label: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component

febrile_or_active_infection.label: Fever, febrile neutropenia or active infection requiring treatment
febrile_or_active_infection.assessment_guidance: Legacy combined field cannot distinguish neutropenic fever from another infection. It triggers clinical review without assuming the neutropenic-fever dose reduction; use the dedicated neutropenic-fever field when confirmed.

other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.label: Worst relevant non-haematological toxicity EXCLUDING mucositis and alopecia
other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.grading_source_label: NCCP00319 v5 Table3: grading edition unspecified
other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.source_grading_note: The source specifies grades but no grading system edition. Confirm the named adverse event and grade using the locally verified grading policy; this selector is not a complete grading aid. Mucositis and alopecia are excluded from Table3.
other_nonhaem_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Select the confirmed grade for a named non-haematological event other than mucositis or alopecia. No generic CTCAE5 definition is substituted.

gfr_crcl_ml_min.label: GFR / CrCl used for carboplatin dosing

renal_input.reason: Carboplatin Calvert dosing needs a verified continuous GFR; source caps dosing GFR at125mL/min. This entry does not silently establish etoposide CrCl.

etoposide_renal_band.label: Legacy etoposide renal band (exact current CrCl preferred)

renal_input.reason: Legacy bands preserved; current source boundaries are10and50. Ambiguous legacy bands require exact confirmation.

etoposide_renal_band.assessment_guidance: Preserved for input compatibility. Old ≥50 band includes source boundary50 and old <15 spans current10 threshold; enter verified CrCl to resolve. No legacy band is silently assumed normal.

bilirubin_uln_multiple.label: Bilirubin result (actual value entered; ×ULN calculated automatically)
bilirubin_uln_multiple.assessment_guidance: Legacy ratio retained for compatibility only. NCCP00319 v5 uses absolute bilirubin50µmol/L plus albumin and renal context. Supply the absolute result; a ratio alone does not authorize a percentage.

febrile_neutropenia.label: Neutropenic fever in the treatment interval

etoposide_crcl_ml_min.label: Verified creatinine clearance for oral etoposide

renal_input.reason: Source renal bands >50,10–50 and haemodialysis; <10 without dialysis is not assigned a dose.

renal_function_normal.label: Renal function confirmed normal for hepatic etoposide rule

creatinine_age_hours.label: Age of creatinine sample for estimated GFR

creatinine_percent_of_isotope_baseline.label: Current creatinine as percentage of isotope baseline

renal_estimate_unreliable.label: Obesity, low serum creatinine or other concern makes estimated GFR unreliable

oral_dose_confirmed.label: Oral capsule dose, twice-daily Days1–3 schedule and handling confirmed

oral_adherence_problem.label: Missed/vomited oral dose, swallowing difficulty or adherence concern

interacting_medicine_or_live_vaccine.label: Potentially interacting medicine or live vaccine identified

mucositis_grade.label: Mucositis grade (excluded from generic Table3)
mucositis_grade.grading_source_label: NCCP00319 v5 Table3 exception; grading edition unspecified
mucositis_grade.source_grading_note: Mucositis is explicitly excluded from the generic percentage rule; grading edition unspecified. Confirm event grade locally; no source-specific percentage is supplied.

action.recommendation: Do not administer carboplatin when GFR≤20mL/min. This explicit prohibition controls the overlap at20.

rules.explanation: Do not administer carboplatin when GFR≤20mL/min. This explicit prohibition controls the overlap at20.

action.recommendation: GFR>20to≤30mL/min: carboplatin requires extreme caution and specialist review.

rules.explanation: GFR>20to≤30mL/min: carboplatin requires extreme caution and specialist review.

action.recommendation: Renal impairment below60mL/min increases carboplatin myelosuppression risk; verify GFR/CrCl meaning. This does not override any hold or contraindication.

rules.explanation: Renal impairment below60mL/min increases carboplatin myelosuppression risk; verify GFR/CrCl meaning. This does not override any hold or contraindication.

action.recommendation: Calvert dosing GFR must not exceed125mL/min. Verify method and apply source cap; do not use the entered higher value unmodified.

rules.explanation: Calvert dosing GFR must not exceed125mL/min. Verify method and apply source cap; do not use the entered higher value unmodified.

action.recommendation: Estimated renal function requires creatinine sampled within48hours of administration; refresh before dosing.

rules.explanation: Estimated renal function requires creatinine sampled within48hours of administration; refresh before dosing.

action.recommendation: Creatinine exceeds110%of isotope baseline: consider remeasuring GFR or verified estimation; old dose is not automatically valid.

rules.explanation: Creatinine exceeds110%of isotope baseline: consider remeasuring GFR or verified estimation; old dose is not automatically valid.

action.recommendation: Measured GFR preferred when obesity/low creatinine makes estimates unreliable. Source discusses adjusted ideal body weight and creatinine handling as options; prescriber/pharmacy must select the method.

rules.explanation: Measured GFR preferred when obesity/low creatinine makes estimates unreliable. Source discusses adjusted ideal body weight and creatinine handling as options; prescriber/pharmacy must select the method.

action.recommendation: Oral etoposide:75%of the original dose at CrCl10–50mL/min; increase only if tolerated after specialist review. Reconcile any concurrent hepatic or toxicity reduction.

rules.explanation: Oral etoposide:75%of the original dose at CrCl10–50mL/min; increase only if tolerated after specialist review. Reconcile any concurrent hepatic or toxicity reduction.

action.recommendation: Source Table2 gives no non-dialysis CrCl<10mL/min dose. Obtain specialist renal/pharmacy direction; do not extrapolate75%.

rules.explanation: Source Table2 gives no non-dialysis CrCl<10mL/min dose. Obtain specialist renal/pharmacy direction; do not extrapolate75%.

action.recommendation: Etoposide is not dialysed; source says consider75%of original dose in haemodialysis. Confirm specialist plan. This does not authorise the carboplatin component.

rules.explanation: Etoposide is not dialysed; source says consider75%of original dose in haemodialysis. Confirm specialist plan. This does not authorise the carboplatin component.

action.recommendation: Verify carboplatin renal eligibility and specialist dialysis plan; do not treat etoposide dialysis advice as permission for carboplatin.

rules.explanation: Verify carboplatin renal eligibility and specialist dialysis plan; do not treat etoposide dialysis advice as permission for carboplatin.

action.recommendation: Legacy15–49mL/min falls within current10–50 band:75%of original etoposide dose, then consider tolerance. Verify actual CrCl and any other restrictions.

rules.explanation: Legacy15–49mL/min falls within current10–50 band:75%of original etoposide dose, then consider tolerance. Verify actual CrCl and any other restrictions.

action.recommendation: Carboplatin GFR does not independently confirm etoposide CrCl. Supply the verified etoposide renal measure; omission is not normal.

action.recommendation: Bilirubin≥50µmol/L OR decreased albumin: consider50%of etoposide dose, increasing if tolerated. This is a consultant decision, not a mandatory calculated dose; reconcile renal/toxicity restrictions.

rules.explanation: Bilirubin≥50µmol/L OR decreased albumin: consider50%of etoposide dose, increasing if tolerated. This is a consultant decision, not a mandatory calculated dose; reconcile renal/toxicity restrictions.

action.recommendation: Bilirubin<50 alone does not establish no adjustment: source also requires normal albumin AND normal renal function. Complete context and reconcile renal rules.

rules.explanation: Bilirubin<50 alone does not establish no adjustment: source also requires normal albumin AND normal renal function. Complete context and reconcile renal rules.

action.recommendation: Current source uses absolute bilirubin50µmol/L; legacy bilirubin×ULN alone cannot resolve this threshold. Supply absolute bilirubin plus albumin/renal context.

rules.explanation: Current source uses absolute bilirubin50µmol/L; legacy bilirubin×ULN alone cannot resolve this threshold. Supply absolute bilirubin plus albumin/renal context.

action.recommendation: For grade≥3 toxicity OTHER THAN mucositis/alopecia: delay until recovery to Grade1, then reduce both drugs to75%. Source does not name a grading edition; confirm event and grade locally.

rules.explanation: For grade≥3 toxicity OTHER THAN mucositis/alopecia: delay until recovery to Grade1, then reduce both drugs to75%. Source does not name a grading edition; confirm event and grade locally.

action.recommendation: Severe mucositis needs clinical assessment. Source explicitly excludes mucositis from the generic75%rule and gives no separate numerical dose pathway; do not borrow it.

rules.explanation: Severe mucositis needs clinical assessment. Source explicitly excludes mucositis from the generic75%rule and gives no separate numerical dose pathway; do not borrow it.

action.recommendation: Resolve prescribed capsule strength/count, twice-daily Days1–3 schedule and safe handling with oncology pharmacy before oral administration. Do not substitute IV etoposide doses.

rules.explanation: Resolve prescribed capsule strength/count, twice-daily Days1–3 schedule and safe handling with oncology pharmacy before oral administration. Do not substitute IV etoposide doses.

action.recommendation: Contact the treating team/pharmacist for missed/vomited doses or swallowing difficulty. Do not double, replace, extend or convert doses without their explicit instructions.

rules.explanation: Contact the treating team/pharmacist for missed/vomited doses or swallowing difficulty. Do not double, replace, extend or convert doses without their explicit instructions.

action.recommendation: The source course ends at progression or unacceptable toxicity. Review stopping/changing the plan before further treatment; no fixed cycle number overrides this.

rules.explanation: The source course ends at progression or unacceptable toxicity. Review stopping/changing the plan before further treatment; no fixed cycle number overrides this.

action.recommendation: Review current product information and interaction databases with pharmacy, including live vaccines; confirm the plan before treatment.

rules.explanation: Review current product information and interaction databases with pharmacy, including live vaccines; confirm the plan before treatment.

exclusions: Hypersensitivity to carboplatin, etoposide or excipients; exceptional mild carboplatin rechallenge requires specialist controlled desensitisation.
monitoring: Baseline blood/renal/liver profile; measured isotope GFR preferred or verified GFR/CrCl estimate; audiology as clinically indicated.
FBC weekly prior to treatment; renal and liver profile before each cycle.
Regular neurological/hearing review, particularly with high carboplatin exposure, previous platinum/ototoxic agents and age>65.
Disease monitoring and further tests according to Consultant plan; oral adherence and complete medicines review.
dose_modifications: All changes discussed with Consultant. Full-dose count row visually confirmed ANC≥1 AND platelets≥100. Platelets50–<75 unassigned: specialist review.
Bilirubin≥50µmol/L or low albumin:consider50%; normal-dose expectation requires bilirubin<50 AND normal albumin AND normal renal function.
Grade≥3 OTHER THAN mucositis/alopecia:delay untilGrade1 then75%bothdrugs. Grading edition unspecified.
No automatic IV/oral conversion, renal/hepatic percentage multiplication, or capsule rounding.

supportive_care.mapping_source: NCCP00319 v5 and NCIS Medical Oncology antiemetics V8

additional_supportive_care: Confirm oral capsule prescription, handling, missed/vomited dose contact plan.

treatment_phases.label: Carboplatin Day1 plus oral etoposide Days1–3

administration.notes: Each dose100mg/m², twice daily on Days1–3; capsules on empty stomach; pharmacist specifies capsule count and dose rounding. No automatic IV/oral conversion.

notes: Repeat21days until progression or unacceptable toxicity. Carboplatin before etoposide on Day1.
Calvert dose=AUC×(verified GFR+25); cap GFR125mL/min; measured GFR preferred.
Oral exposure variable; source warns against predicting oral dose from IV dose. Titrate under specialist review.
